rows.subject: src/pages/brand-chat.tsx:927 — unmatched selection falls back to an arbitrary room and latches

evidence.result: :922-926 computes match from ?deal= then ?creator=, then :927 runs setSelectedDeal(match || liveDealRooms[0]) — so an absent OR unmatched param opens a different creator's thread. :921 guards the whole effect on `selectedDeal`, so that wrong pick is permanent: no later loadDealRooms() refresh can correct it, and while the list is still empty the effect returns at :921 and nothing opens at all. brand-messages.tsx:396-405 already has the correct shape (return without selecting when a param was supplied but unmatched, 'Never fall back to a different creator's thread — audit #10'); brand-chat.tsx never received it

rows.subject: src/pages/brand-creator-profile.tsx:571 — ?creator= carries a CreatorProfile id, the thread list keys on a User id

evidence.result: DealService.java:1139-1143 returns new Counterparty(collaboration.getCreatorId(), ...) and resolves the profile with creatorProfileRepository.findByUserId(...) at :1138, so counterpartyId is a USER id. brand-messages.tsx:274 keys the thread list on it, while brand-creator-profile.tsx:571 navigates with ?creator=<CreatorProfile id> (api.ts:1551 states that contract). The lookup at brand-messages.tsx:400 therefore never matches, and because that file correctly refuses to fall back, the brand lands on /brand/messages with no thread selected. NOT true of brand-campaign-detail.tsx:1224 — dealToBidView at :294 sets creator.id = deal.counterpartyId, the same User-id space, so that caller matches correctly
